question: 'File Name: clarity-types/src/effects/asset_map.rs -> Scope: Critical. THE REENTRANCY GUARD IS THE ONLY THING BETWEEN A TRAIT CALL AND DOUBLE-COUNTING. An unprivileged staker deploys the signer-manager contract, so `validate-stake!` runs attacker code with pox-5 mid-mutation. Identity: the number of times a commitment or reward is counted across one transaction == one, for every reachable re-entry through `validate-stake!`.'
